title: Batch 3: narrow deferred-chat candidate validated, not deployed
summary: Candidate passed build, TypeScript, focused lint, mobile/chat/failure-recovery and SEO checks. Matched local median LCP improves 2.200s to 2.084s; no live sub-2.5s claim. Exact three-file source awaits approval.

changes.detail: DeferredChatWidget moves optional chat JS/CSS after page load/idle or loads on early scroll; catches failed chunk downloads with at most three attempts.
Root layout uses deferred entry; existing chat checks current scroll position at mount. No font, branding, catalogue, payment, authentication or inventory changes.
